name: pocketbase
description: Build and operate PocketBase backends: an operational skill for driving a running instance (collection and record CRUD, auth, backups, migration generation, Go hooks and custom routes), a design skill of 63 prioritized rules for schema, API rules, auth flows, query performance, realtime, files, and deployment, and three subject-matter agents that carry the backend laws into a delegated brief: a builder, an adversarial reviewer, and a security auditor, each proving its claims from its own clean-room server.
